rules.requirement: Execute with at least 15 nested blocks in C90 and C95, or 127 in later editions.
Translate at least 8 nested preprocessing conditionals in C90 and C95, or 63 in later editions.
Accept a declaration with 12 type modifiers made up of pointers, arrays, and functions.
Accept a declarator nested in 31 pairs of parentheses in C90 and C95, or 63 in later editions.
Accept an expression nested in 32 pairs of parentheses in C90 and C95, or 63 in later editions.
Distinguish internal identifiers and macro names at character 31 in C90 and C95, or character 63 in later editions.
Distinguish external identifiers at character 6 in C90 and C95, or character 31 in later editions.
Translate at least 511 external identifiers in C90 and C95, or 4,095 in later editions.
Accept a block with at least 127 block-scope names in C90 and C95, or 511 in later editions.
Define at least 1,024 macros simultaneously in C90 and C95, or 4,095 in later editions.
Accept a definition with at least 31 function parameters in C90 and C95, or 127 in later editions.
Pass at least 31 arguments in one call in C90 and C95, or 127 in later editions.
Declare at least 31 parameters to one macro in C90 and C95, or 127 in later editions.
Substitute at least 31 arguments in one macro invocation in C90 and C95, or 127 in later editions.
Translate a logical source line of 509 characters in C90 and C95, or 4,095 in later editions.
Construct a concatenated narrow or wide string literal of at least 509 characters in C90 and C95, or 4,095 in later editions.
Store and read an object occupying at least 32,767 bytes in C90 and C95, or 65,535 in later editions.
Reach a header through 8 nested inclusions in C90 and C95, or 15 in later editions.
Execute a switch with at least 257 case labels in C90 and C95, or 1,023 in later editions.
Access members of one record containing at least 127 members in C90 and C95, or 1,023 in later editions.
Accept at least 127 enumeration constants in C90 and C95, or 1,023 in later editions.
Access a member through at least 15 nested record definitions in C90 and C95, or 63 in later editions.
Use the presumed filename and line in a following diagnostic.
Resolve quoted headers from the directory of the current physical includer.
Recognize a source header-name token and resolve macro-produced header operands.
Include the directive message tokens when diagnosing an active #error.
Initialize narrow string arrays from adjacent tokens with an embedded zero and a separate final null.
Encode a supplementary character as two UTF-16 code units and retain both the embedded and final zeros.
Encode a supplementary character as one UTF-32 code unit and retain both the embedded and final zeros.
Provide the specified minimum integer ranges as preprocessing integer constant expressions and a positive MB_LEN_MAX.
Make CHAR_MIN and CHAR_MAX agree with the actual signedness of plain char.
Give each integer limit the type of the corresponding standard integer type after integer promotion.
Report the selected floating formats, evaluation method, significand digits, exponents, finite extrema and epsilon in float.h.
Advertise the supported subnormals and expose the exact least positive value of each type.
Report default round-to-nearest through FLT_ROUNDS in the selected header and runtime.

rules.outside_profile: Wasm selects round-to-nearest for ordinary arithmetic and has no directed rounding modes.
rules.requirement: Map all four native C fenv modes to the standard rounding codes through __builtin_flt_rounds.

rules.outside_profile: This rule checks arithmetic under a non-default native rounding mode.
rules.requirement: Honor the active rounding mode in scalar double arithmetic with FENV_ACCESS ON, including block scope and _Pragma.

Accept the scoped complex-range pragma and preserve scaled division and infinity recovery in the OFF and DEFAULT scopes. Exercise elementary complex multiplication and division with safe operands under ON.

rules.outside_profile: The probe requires observable floating-point status flags.
rules.requirement: Preserve invalid from a discarded full-range complex quotient and inexact from a discarded limited-range complex quotient under FENV_ACCESS ON.

rules.outside_profile: The native profile exercises status flags in a separate rule.
rules.requirement: Compute the round-to-nearest limited-range complex quotient in a scope with FENV_ACCESS ON.

Honor file, block, and _Pragma settings for FP_CONTRACT. Preserve separate rounding under OFF and restore the enclosing setting after a block. The AArch64 profile also checks its chosen same-expression multiply-add contraction.

rules.outside_profile: This rule checks arithmetic under a non-default native rounding mode.
rules.requirement: Preserve the inexact status effect of a discarded arithmetic result in a region with FENV_ACCESS ON.

rules.outside_profile: This rule checks arithmetic under a non-default native rounding mode.
rules.requirement: Honor directed rounding for int to float and double to float and preserve invalid for an out-of-range float to int conversion.

rules.outside_profile: This test requires a hosted runtime with accessible floating-point status and rounding controls.
rules.requirement: In a scope with FENV_ACCESS ON, sqrt observes downward rounding and raises inexact when the result is discarded. A discarded pow raises divide-by-zero on a negative zero raised to -1. Calls to sin and cos of infinity each raise invalid when a flag clear intervenes.

rules.outside_profile: This probe qualifies default rounding results of the math library on WASI.
rules.requirement: Check the square root interfaces and a double power result with the selected WASI math library.

rules.outside_profile: This rule checks the native invalid exception flag for a floating comparison.
rules.requirement: Raise invalid for an ordered relational comparison with a quiet NaN under FENV_ACCESS ON.

rules.outside_profile: This rule checks the native invalid exception flag for a floating comparison.
rules.requirement: Compare a quiet NaN through equality and isless without setting the invalid flag.

Classify long double values from signed zeros and subnormals to infinities and quiet NaNs, and give all six quiet comparisons their ordered and unordered results in the underlying compiler operations.
Exercise classification and quiet comparison through the selected hosted math.h macros for all three standard real floating types.
Initialize static real floating objects with a quiet NaN or signed infinity from division by zero. Native startup leaves the floating exception flags clear.

rules.outside_profile: This rule checks the native invalid exception flag where long double has binary128 format.
rules.requirement: Classify and quietly compare binary128 quiet NaNs without invalid, and raise invalid for a scoped relational comparison even when its result is discarded.
Qualify the minimum ranges and numeric limits macros on the selected target.
Diagnose a flexible array in a union, before a later member, or in a struct with no other named member.
Diagnose by-value use of a flexible record as a struct member or array element under the pedantic policy, including through recursively containing unions.
Diagnose a record member of function type even when the type comes from a typedef.
Diagnose a nonempty direct initializer of a flexible array member under the pedantic policy, with both positional and designated forms.
Access the flexible tail within allocated storage and check the header after an ordinary struct copy.

Accept a flexible record as a union member including through another union, and accept arrays of pointers to the record. In C11 and C17, count a name injected by an anonymous union when checking the struct's named members.

rules.clause: AMD1 (Multibyte Support Extension and alternative tokens)
rules.requirement: Compose iso646.h, wchar.h, and wctype.h for restartable conversions, string operations, and classification in the C locale.
Expose static_assert, alignas, alignof and noreturn in their headers. A member alignment raises the aggregate alignment, the static object meets that alignment and the noreturn declaration is usable.
Allocate a 128-byte object at 64-byte alignment, permit access at both ends and free it using the selected libc.
Use TIME_UTC and struct timespec from <time.h>. Obtain the requested time base and a normalized nanosecond field.
Convert basic execution characters and the null character through the C-locale UTF-16 and UTF-32 interfaces. Verify byte counts and code units.
Call successfully registered at_quick_exit handlers in reverse registration order.
Create a file with mode wx, reject a second exclusive open and retain the original contents.
Expose the default hosted atomic interface. Check read-modify-write, compare-exchange, flag operations and agreement with the lock-free macro.

rules.outside_profile: This probe qualifies the C11 thread entry points of the selected Linux runtimes.
rules.requirement: Exercise the advertised C11 thread library. Verify the start callback and join result, thread-local isolation, call_once, thread-specific storage and its destructor, and condition-variable handoff under a mutex.
Match the target compiler predefines. Define __STDC_NO_THREADS__ as 1 on Darwin. Leave it undefined on Linux, WASI and bare Wasm before including any runtime headers.
Leave __STDC_VERSION__ undefined in the unamended C90 profile.
Define __STDC_VERSION__ as 199409L in the C95 profile.
Define __STDC_VERSION__ as 202311L in the C23 profile.
Look up a direct header name as written and process a tokenized operand with normal macro replacement.
Leave trigraph sequences unchanged in the default C23 lexical profile, including before backslash-newline splicing.
Use XID_Start and XID_Continue for raw and escaped Unicode identifiers and diagnose identifiers outside Normalization Form C.
Permit universal character names for basic, control and NUL characters within quoted literals, while enforcing the restrictions on malformed names and surrogate values.
Read binary integer constants with the nondecimal base and suffix rules for value and type.
Recognize digit separators in integer and floating constants, including exponent digits, and preserve preprocessing token boundaries through stringization and pasting.
Select elifdef and elifndef branches by macro definedness, sharing the conditional group's skip and state rules.
Recognize bool as a type specifier and true and false as bool constants. Treat true as 1 and false as 0 in preprocessing conditions.
Accept static_assert with and without a message, including bool integer constant expressions.
Reserve typeof and typeof_unqual as keywords and accept their parenthesized type-name and expression operands.
Preserve the operand type in typeof and remove top-level qualifiers in typeof_unqual, preserving pointee qualifiers and array atomic element types.
Evaluate a typeof or typeof_unqual operand only when its type is variably modified, retaining written bounds and nested evaluation.
Diagnose both typeof operators on operands designating a bit-field.
Reserve nullptr as a predefined constant of its own scalar type. Use pointer-compatible size, alignment and null representation, and use null for default and empty initialization.
Allow nullptr_t values to be converted to void, bool and pointer types, and allow nullptr_t and null pointer constants to initialize or assign nullptr_t. Preserve operand effects.
Apply the nullptr_t equality, logical and conditional operand rules. Preserve pointer type in a mixed conditional and reject ordered comparisons and integer null constant conditional arms.
Recognize alignas and alignof and apply the existing type and alignment rules to their operands.
Allow a variadic function type with no named parameters. Start traversal from its first argument without an anchor, and allow variadic nullptr_t values to be read as void or character pointers.

Form a distinct integer type for each width and signedness within the advertised limits. Check the width's constant expression and range. Use the declared precision for bit-fields, conversions and arithmetic.
Interpret wb and WB constants at the smallest representable precision. In preprocessing conditions evaluate them in the intmax_t or uintmax_t domain.
Preserve bit-precise values across calls, unnamed arguments, case label comparisons, and atomic updates.
Give constexpr object definitions const qualification and file-scope internal linkage, preserve automatic addresses, and check the permitted declaration types and storage specifiers.
Use named constants and recursive dot members in matching constant expressions. Reject ordinary object reads, array subscripts, and reads of inactive union members in these expressions.

Require exactly representable written initializer values and null pointer values. Check integer expression form, real and complex domains, signaling NaNs, bit-field widths, overwritten designators and UTF-8 code units.
Infer an object's type after lvalue, array-to-pointer and function-to-pointer conversions, apply the declared qualifiers and capture any runtime bounds once.

Reserve the pending inferred name during its initializer and require an initialized object declaration. Accept a single identifier declarator with optional parentheses and attributes. Restrict auto with a written type to block-scope objects without another storage class.
Recognize both spellings of the thread storage class and preserve thread duration when the object type is inferred.

Permit empty initialization of an automatic variable-length array and default-initialize its entire captured extent. Diagnose nonempty VLA initializers, VLA compound literals, and empty initializers for arrays of unknown bound.
Treat __has_c_attribute as defined in conditional directives, and report the supported revision for a known standard attribute and zero for unsupported attributes.
Accept omitted variable arguments, and expand __VA_OPT__ with the correct empty or nonempty result, including stringization and pasting.
Diagnose a reached warning directive using its written preprocessing tokens. A warning directive does not require translation to fail.
Replace a resource directive with its comma-separated byte values and report a missing or unsupported required resource.
Apply limit, prefix, suffix and if_empty, including alternative parameter spellings, and diagnose malformed and repeated parameters.
Use the same search and effective resource size as embed to distinguish zero for unavailable or unsupported resources, one for nonempty resources and two for empty resources.
